items.statement: V1.2 report identifies repository wage98/boji-diary, branch main, commit cbccea4, APP_VERSION 1.2.0 and SW cache boji-1-2-0.
V1.2 report states 55 functional + 196 attack = 251 ALL PASSED.
V1.2 report documents local Web Speech-based emotion/prosody behavior, lifecycle stop/sync behavior, and unsupported-browser fallback.
V1.2 report documents 72 exercise video entries, 52 unique training videos and 10 knowledge videos, plus embedded/original-site/local-file fallback behavior.
Legacy training completion uses exercise-level boolean semantics; custom completion shares completion namespace and can contaminate planned completion/progression.
Legacy running path contains correctness/performance risks including full rerender ticker, route sampling endpoint risk, and UTC/local-date inconsistency.
Legacy save call paths can acknowledge success despite persistence failure.
Legacy Food AI semantics can expose uncalibrated model confidence and fabricate/rescale nutrition values.
Boji is a local-first personal training companion, strength-training first.
Primary IA is 今日 | 训练 | Boji | 进步 | 我的.
Official Boji direction is an original anime-style sweet adult female training companion.
Earlier corgi-based product preview is non-authoritative and must not be used as final asset.
Live V1 HEAD/tree has not yet been independently verified.
Reported 251 tests have not yet been reproduced in a clean environment.
Final production character asset has not yet been frozen.

Live V1 HEAD is c0a8d55283765a0f7d7e4d773df0609ba1e4049d; cbccea4c47995711d1ae0af2d7c76449febe2603 is the historical v1.2 anchor; the two intervening commits are docs-only and qualified app.js/sw.js/tools bytes are identical.
Historical 251 ALL PASSED is conditionally reproduced; the conditions are generated eval artifacts, no local-day-2 legacy fixture trigger, and no D1 timing flake.
F1/F2 are fixture/date-environment defects, not product defects: seed threshold >=3 conflicts with test threshold >=2, causing local-day-2 failure.
J15/K8 depend on ignored generated eval artifacts; selfcheck lacks deterministic setup and the generators assume eval-set already exists.
D1 is a timing flake: isolated product behavior is correct but the fixed test budget is too tight under suite load.
Portable harness feasibility is verified with jsdom 28.1.0 and qrcode 1.5.4 using standard local Node resolution.
